crew.overview: John Constantine has literally been to Hell and back. When he teams up with a policewoman to solve the mysterious suicide of her twin sister, their investigation takes them through the world of demons and angels that exists beneath the landscape of contemporary Los Angeles.
crew.title: Constantine

crew.overview: When siblings Judy and Peter discover an enchanted board game that opens the door to a magical world, they unwittingly invite Alan -- an adult who's been trapped inside the game for 26 years -- into their living room. Alan's only hope for freedom is to finish the game, which proves risky as all three find themselves running from giant rhinoceroses, evil monkeys and other terrifying creatures.
crew.title: Jumanji

crew.overview: It ain't easy bein' green -- especially if you're a likable (albeit smelly) ogre named Shrek. On a mission to retrieve a gorgeous princess from the clutches of a fire-breathing dragon, Shrek teams up with an unlikely compatriot -- a wisecracking donkey.
crew.title: Shrek

details.biography: James Satoru Straus is known for his work on Dragonheart (1996), Jurassic Park (1993), G.I. Joe (2009), Star Trek: Insurrection (1998) and Dark was the Night.  He is an animation director, writter, artist and animation supervisor.
details.name: James Straus
